summary: Ibis implementation of the relation system, covering the same eight Substrait-aligned mixins and Mountainash extension ops as other backends and running against multiple SQL dialects. Beyond the composed IbisRelationSystem it holds physical-schema description (schema_metadata), the owned-copy transaction boundary (_physical) and SQLite compatibility/storage shims.
key_classes: IbisRelationSystem — registered (IBIS) relation system composing the base mixin, eight Substrait-aligned mixins (read, project, filter, sort, fetch, join, aggregate, set) and the Mountainash extension mixin by multiple inheritance
IbisBaseRelationSystem — identifies the backend, supplies export/import_into/check_import and name-inference hooks
schema_metadata (module) — physical output-schema description for bound SQL relations via per-dialect techniques
_physical (module) — non-owning SQL physical boundary for owned-copy materialization; refuses unknown dialects
key_functions: register_relation_system(CONST_BACKEND.IBIS) — decorator in the package __init__ registering the composed class
declare_lowering(method[, LoweringDescriptor]) — module-level loop declaring every lowering method reusable; pivot declared REPEATABLE with materializes_input=True
extension_points: Subclass/compose a Substrait*/Mountainash* mixin and add it to the composed class bases
BaseRelationSystem hooks: infer_row_index_names, infer_cross_join_names, export, import_into, check_import, native_scan_eligible
lifecycle_notes: Latest change: 08ac43e6 feat(resources): confine native and fallback resource reads; decision-7 allow-list (381)
3b4cc887 lazy check_import payload so non-SQLite destinations never export
documentation_hooks: Backend implementation guide: adding a relation operation to a backend
Execution locations and Arrow import/export boundary
examples: Dispatched via the relation visitor: ma.relation(df).filter(...).collect() routes to the registered system for the frame's backend
risks: Dialect-dependent behaviour (ibis-sqlite, ibis-duckdb, ibis-polars, ibis-postgres ...): row index unsupported on ibis-polars; SQLite cannot store NaN/Decimal/nested types
Owned-copy transactions are delegated to mountainash-data (optional, lazily imported); idle connections only
Seeded exact-count sample is unsupported on Ibis

evidence.detail: describe_output_schema uses physical technique when location is bound; export canonicalises list child names
owned_adoption_refusal consults IMPORT_INTO GATE declaration; raises BackendCapabilityError
per-dialect techniques describing compiled output query
